description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData' which extends 'BaseChangeableOpenmrsData' and implements 'FormRecordable'. It provides static utility methods for managing form namespace and path data, as well as properties and methods related to form namespace and path handling in the OpenMRS data model.

classes.name: BaseFormRecordableOpenmrsData
classes.description: An abstract base class in the OpenMRS project for form recordable data that bridges entities with form paths and namespaces, including static utility methods for managing form namespace and path strings.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Static method that extracts the namespace part from a combined form namespace and path string.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Static method that extracts the path part from a combined form namespace and path string.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets the 'formNamespaceAndPath' property based on provided namespace and form field path, combining them using the separator.

methods.name: getFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Constructs a combined namespace and path string from individual parts, verifying length constraints and separator count.
